name: k-skill-korean-writing
description: Edit Korean text for clarity while preserving facts, quotations, and tone.

interface.longDescription: Edit Korean text that you provide in the current conversation. The skill improves awkward phrasing and translationese while preserving names, dates, figures, quotations, claims, and level of formality. It has no file access, external service, login flow, executable helper, proxy, or background job.
